_why: Machine translation errors, hand-corrected. Hebrew->English is NOT reliable on medical terms: it rendered לוקמיה (leukemia) as 'working with milk and milk'. Captions only - the audio is untouched and stays in Hebrew.

corrections.you can't lift your hands up when it's h: you can't give up when it's hard
corrections.to shake and to be a little bit sad: you can shake, be a little sad
